title: LabProvider capability report (v0.2)
description: Machine-verifiable capability report emitted by every LabProvider. Scenario meta.requires is validated against the same vocabulary; matching is done by lab/providers/scheduler.py. Reports must state substrate truth (e.g. the e2b TCG provider reports emulator_acceleration 'none' — never 'kvm'). v0.2 (CLI-first, operator directive 2026-09-23): android_sdk / android_cli / gradle are first-class required capabilities; android_studio is demoted to OPTIONAL environment metadata — it must never appear in scenario meta.requires and never gate scheduling.

verified_utc.description: when the capability claims were last empirically verified (acceptance gate); null = claimed, not yet verified

android_sdk.description: Android SDK installed and CLI-installable (cmdline-tools + platform-tools + platforms + build-tools)

android_cli.description: terminal-accessible Android CLI tooling (sdkmanager/avdmanager and/or the newer unified 'android' CLI) — the CLI-first worker stack; never requires an IDE

gradle.description: Gradle build capability (wrapper distribution usable from the terminal)

android_studio.description: OPTIONAL environment metadata only (IDE present for optional human debugging/inspection). NOT a matchable capability, NOT a scenario requirement, never gates scheduling — CLI-first architecture.

notes.description: per-capability provenance notes (e.g. how camera_fixture is realized)
